[EN] This surveying is going much more slowly than I was hoping—and certainly more slowly than Ackerly was expecting. These pesky {@LinkCreature:5#14#Muddy Sporewalkers} keep wandering around, blocking my way.

If you could get them out of my way, I'd be able to actually finish the job here and get reports back to Ackerly.
[ES] Este estudio va mucho más lento de lo que esperaba, y ciertamente más lento de lo que Ackerly esperaba. Estos molestos {@LinkCreature:5#14#Muddy Sporewalkers} siguen deambulando por ahí, bloqueando mi camino.

Si pudieras quitarlos de mi camino, podría terminar el trabajo aquí y enviar los informes a Ackerly.

[EN] Oh, thanks! It's going to be so much easier to finish this surveying without those pests in the way.

Here's something for your trouble.
[ES] ¡Oh, gracias! Va a ser mucho más fácil terminar este estudio sin esas plagas en el medio.

Aquí tienes algo por tu molestia.
